candidate_adr.heading: Draft ADR: service-mediated writes
candidate_adr.text: Production writes are mediated by the service layer. Exceptions (for example bulk import jobs) must be explicitly recorded in the ADR as carve-outs. Status: candidate, under review.

a8ed0f.heading: Network change notes
a8ed0f.text: Per the earlier agreement, ingest keeps the legacy path.

route__a8ed0f.instructions: Task: decide whether ONE evidence snippet should be forwarded to be considered TOGETHER with the candidate ADR in the state field candidate_adr, for the Architect's ADR (Architecture Decision Record) work. The candidate ADR and all evidence remain archived; this only assembles a combined consideration view. "unrelated" means EXCLUDED FROM THIS VIEW ONLY - it never deletes any source. The evidence snippet is the entry in the state whose unit_id is "a8ed0f" (fields: heading, text, context). Judge THIS snippet against the candidate ADR using its own supplied text, heading and context. Source context is supplied up front where available; the Architect can request more later if needed. Options: consider_together = forward the snippet to be considered alongside the candidate ADR: it bears on the ADR's decision, constraint, rationale, alternative or consequence - or it is ambiguous and might do so: when in doubt, consider_together; possibly useful material is forwarded, not silently discarded. unrelated = EXCLUDED FROM THIS VIEW ONLY (never deletion): clearly unrelated material - operational chatter, routine logistics, or a scope with no bearing on the candidate ADR. Forwarding is not approval and not a claim of current validity. Do not fill gaps from general knowledge. Consider only unit "a8ed0f".

criteria.consider_together: Forward alongside the candidate ADR: material bearing on its decision / constraint / rationale / alternative / consequence, or ambiguous material that might do so - when in doubt, forward. Forwarding is not approval.
criteria.unrelated: Excluded from this combined view only (never delete the source): clearly unrelated material - operational chatter, logistics, or scope with no bearing on the candidate ADR.
